diagnostic_cost.interpretation: Whole parent H0+H1 run cost per correct H1 reference-gate crossing under each target; null work is charged, export/provisioning/calibration are excluded; NOT operationally validated.

diagnostic_throughput.denominator: External parent-process wall seconds from the stage driver; charges both H0 and H1 scoring, excludes input export, provisioning and calibration.

numerators.correct_h1_gate_crossings_per_second: Correct H1 reference-gate crossings only, at most 384 per report and target.
numerators.paired_observations_per_second: 768 total captures per report = 384 H0/H1 pairs.

diagnostic_throughput.qualification: Diagnostic throughput; performance and policy gains are NOT operationally qualified.

fusion.baseline_end_usage: Separately reported bracketing controls; excluded from the three-repeat baseline median/range.
fusion.note: Three repeat median and observed min/max; repeat 0 is separately marked and its first compilation/capture cost remains charged. Parent wall uses external driver measurements only; missing parent wall remains null.

limits: Sensitivity-loss budgets 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, and 1 dB remain unqualified unless independently proven; this renderer does not infer or certify a loss.
GPU micro timings and conditional fixed-path decisions do not establish operational false-admission calibration or field sensitivity.
Compiler n_spills metadata is not a PTX spill count; artifact availability is reported separately from instruction verification.
Cost is per diagnostic correct gate crossing and is not an operationally validated result.

methods.baseline: current torch.matmul(T.T, values), strict global precision guards
methods.cpu_subset: cpu_frequency_reference on first trial/candidate/quadrature, same represented FP32 operands
methods.fp64: torch.matmul(T.double().T, values.double()) on the identical represented FP32 inputs
methods.timing: CUDA events and separate host-loop wall, 10 warmups and configured repeats; in-kernel conversion included, output allocation included in host wall

metric_notes.kernel_n_spills: kernel compiler metadata value; not PTX instruction verification.
metric_notes.relative_l1_error: sum absolute output error divided by original/reference output mass as reported by each case.
metric_notes.representation_l1_error: raw state representation L1 error sum divided by state_original_mass.

noise_validation.independence_note: 384 independent noise trials per kind per C/N0 in final protocol; same noise across C/N0 is paired/correlated; all points share the sampled physical path.
